name: Why Normod?
title: Design begins with living.
description: Homes and needs change over time. A modular approach opens up new ways of arranging a living space. Explore which pieces work together with our team.

section-1.title: A home that adapts to you.
section-1.body: Homes and needs change over time. A modular approach opens up new ways of arranging a living space. Explore which pieces work together with our team.

section-2.title: A shared language in the details.
section-2.body: The shape of a leg, the tone of wood or the texture of a fabric. Our collections consider these details together, creating a quiet connection between rooms.

section-3.title: Experience before deciding.
section-3.body: The best way to understand a sofa is to sit on it. Visit us in Nicosia to explore proportions, materials and arrangements together.
